title: Atlas runtime policy manifest v4 (forex: leverage 1:2 margin book and a 100 % stop-out)
note: Successor of v3 (kept unchanged, sealed). Adds the account leverage, as the RiskPolicy and the durable book each hold it (CRYPTO 1, FOREX 2), and the stop-out margin level (1 = 100 %); FOREX runs the exit guard in ENFORCE with two rules, STOP_OUT (SAFETY_EXIT) and WEEKEND_CLOSE (30 minutes). Read-only reference: core/policy_manifest.py compares the running application with it and any difference, or a missing/mismatching ratification, is BLOCK_NEW_RISK. Nothing is applied from this file and it can never enable live trading. Owner values 2026-10-26: leverage 1:2, stop-out 100 %.
owner_approval: SEE_REGISTRY: ratification is recorded in ATLAS_MILESTONE_REGISTRY_v5.108 (this field is informational and is not trusted by the check)
